disclosure.title: This conversation uses AI
disclosure.body: KKD does not diagnose. It helps you describe symptoms before you speak to a healthcare professional. Do not rely on it in an emergency.
consent.saveRecord: Save selected facts to my health record
error.retry: Something went wrong. Please try again.
voice.title: Voice interview
voice.subtitle: Describe what you are experiencing. This is not a doctor and it does not diagnose.
voice.disabled: Voice is turned off for this environment.
voice.mockHandset: Mock handset: this browser is standing in for a phone call. No Twilio number is used.
voice.callFailed: The voice connection could not start. You can still type answers below if the mock call is active.
voice.sendToHospital: Send this record to a hospital near you
voice.locationHint: Nearby care uses your area, not a predicted disease. You can confirm location on the next screen.
voice.smsPhone: Feature-phone number for a text summary (optional)
voice.continueLater: Call me back to continue this interview
voice.job.queued: Queued. If SMS is not wired yet, this is a mock send.
voice.job.inProcess: Accepted without Redis. Mock delivery ran in this process.
voice.urgency.highIntensity: Reported intensity is high. Seek care today.
voice.urgency.needMore: More detail is needed before an urgency class other than unknown can be given.
voice.urgency.soon: No emergency warning sign was identified from the facts collected so far.
